top_signals.title: Can Singapore's Road to Riches Be Replicated Today? | Emerging
top_signals.summary: Singapore’s evolution from colonial trading port to high-tech financial center has been held up as an example to follow for decades. But does it still provide a blueprint in this era of rising protectionism, AI disruption, and geopolitical rivalry? In Emerging, Haslinda Amin sits down with Singapore Ambassador-at-Large Chan Heng Chee and Pushan Dutt, professor of economics and political science at INSEAD, to discuss what drove Singapore’s rise, why China and Vietnam successfully adapted parts of its model, and why many others including India have struggled to replicate that success.  (Source: Bloomberg)

top_signals.title: Commission grants Spain €114.7 million and provides enhanced operational assistance to manage the situation in Ceuta
top_signals.summary: European Commission Press release Brussels, 09 Sep 2026 Today, the Commission has decided to provide Spain with €114.7 million in emergency assistance to help manage the situation in Ceuta, following the large-scale illegal border crossings on 30-31 July. This financial support builds on the Commission's immediate response from the first day, when it offered Spain both financial and operational assistance. The decision further demonstrates the Commission's full solidarity with Spain in addressing the challenging situation.
